name: manymotions-comedy-skit-video
description: Turn a premise into a short comedy skit with original characters, set up fast and landed, produced in your ManyMotions account.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a premise into a short comedy skit with original characters: one joke, set up fast and landed.

Describe the joke, where it happens, the characters and the style (deadpan, absurd, parody, observational or slapstick), plus the spoken language, format and length. The plugin prepares a brief and shows the number of scenes and the credits it will use. When you confirm, ManyMotions writes the script scene by scene, generates the keyframes and the scene videos with AI voices, and edits the final cut. A video takes several minutes; ChatGPT reports the progress and returns the link to the MP4.

For creators of short-form comedy, social media teams and anyone with a funny idea.

Limitations: original characters only, no real people or public figures. It does not edit uploaded footage or use photos of real people. Producing a video uses your signed-in ManyMotions account; preparing a brief does not need an account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same brief opens on ManyMotions.

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
capabilities: Track progress and return the MP4
defaultPrompt: A deadpan skit: an office printer that only works when you compliment it
An absurd skit about a pigeon applying for a job at a bakery, 15 seconds
An observational skit on group chats planning a dinner, in Spanish

positive.prompt: Make a 30-second deadpan skit: an office printer that only works when you compliment it. Two coworkers in an open-plan office.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with style deadpan, 30 seconds, 5 scenes and the credits it will use. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.prompt: An absurd skit about a pigeon applying for a job at a bakery, square 1:1, 15 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with style absurd, format 1:1 and length 15 seconds (3 scenes), and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.description: Produce a video and return it
positive.prompt: An 8-second slapstick skit: a man proudly carries a giant cake through a narrow door. Yes, generate it now and send me the video link when it is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The brief is prepared (2 scenes, 500 credits). After the go-ahead (if ChatGPT asks to confirm first, reply "Generate it"), generate_video starts the production in the signed-in account (state processing, credits used shown). get_video reports the current step; asked again once the production has completed (usually 5 to 10 minutes), it returns the absolute MP4 link and the ManyMotions link to open it.

positive.prompt: A parody skit in the style of a nature documentary about office workers waiting at the coffee machine, 45 seconds, 16:9.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with style parody, format 16:9, length 45 seconds (7 scenes) and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: An observational skit about a group chat trying to choose a restaurant for dinner, in Spanish, 30 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with style observational, language Spanish, 30 seconds and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

negative.prompt: Make a parody where a sitting president slips on a banana peel during a speech.
Add a laugh track and funny captions to the clip I uploaded.
Tell me five jokes about accountants.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing a video uses credits of the user's existing ManyMotions account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission with no functional changes: prepare a brief, produce the video in the linked ManyMotions account and follow it to the MP4.
